notes.title: New / Update Version Beta 0.0.2
notes.content:
-----New / Updates Beta Version 0.0.2-----

1) A shop has been added to buy items on the main island, also the shop is available in each mission in the form of contraband, you will have to get it if you want to buy items in the middle of the mission.

----- Fixed Beta Version 0.0.2 -----

1) In the city a part of the stage was missing, it has been fixed.
2) Fixed a boss spawning on fire and not having a weapon.
